display.title: Episode 292: Little Zalmy and the Spooky House (Chai Elul)
display.summary_short: For Chai Elul, a dramatized story of the Alter Rebbe as a six-year-old, secretly gathering children in a 'haunted' house to teach them brachos and Torah.
display.summary_long: Broadcast a few days before Chai Elul 5747, the birthday of the Baal Shem Tov and the Alter Rebbe. After the Hakochainik march and the Shema with a young studio guest, Uncle Yossi presents a dramatized story set in the town of Liozna. Six-year-old Schneur Zalman, whose parents are known for their hospitality, slips out of the kitchen with two baskets of food on 'a mission to save hungry souls', puzzling the family cook. Meanwhile two classmates, bold Shimmy and nervous Zelig, hide in an abandoned house that the whole town thinks is haunted. The footsteps they hear turn out to belong to Schneur Zalman and a group of children who never went to yeshiva. He shares the treats, teaches them to say brachos and thank Hashem, and comforts a poor boy, Meir, whose parents need his help at home, telling him that Hashem treasures every letter a child learns. Inspired, Shimmy and Zelig decide to gather children themselves, and Uncle Yossi reveals that little Zalmy grew up to be the Baal HaTanya.
display.lesson: You are never too young to do Ahavas Yisroel: share what you have and help other children come close to Hashem and His Torah.

date.note: Consistent with the audio: 'right before the very special day called Chai Elul'.
